notes.title: Bug fixed and improvements
notes.content:
Hello !

If you lost your progression, please use the cheat to go back where you were:
in the menu scene, press both triggers and both grips during 5 seconds. It will unlock all the levels and save your progression from where you choose to go.

Here are the changes:

 I found that there was a big rendering issue with the trees in the bridge level -> bug fixed.
 Smoother locomotion system, the is proportionnal to the finger position on the trackpad.
 Changed the basic spell to move a block in puzzle block 3.
 Changed the dark fireball explosion orientation.


Have fun !

Baptiste

notes.title: Full locomotion update
notes.content:
Hello again !

At first, I didn't include walking in the game since I personally still have motion sickness. But it is now available in the game for the more experienced players.

So, the patch notes are:

 Teleport or smooth locomotion support.
 The difficulty of the game increases faster, the monsters are harder to kill.
 There is a cheat to open all the worlds: from the menu, press both grips and both triggers during 5 seconds and it will open all the portals. Once you  chose your portal, the game will save your progression from there...


Have fun !

Baptiste

notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hello everyone !

I hope you enjoy the game :) 

Here is a new version with some improvements:

 The scene loading is a little bit faster ! Don't turn off the game if it takes time: nothing bugs, just wait longer. Only the first loading is that long, it goes faster for the next levels.
 If you have frame rate issues, please turn down the graphics in Steam VR > Settings > Applications > Application Resolution Adjustment 
And then turn down the resolution. It should run smoother now...
 The game should now have very basic support for the Oculus Rift headset. This support is not official since I do not have the headset to test it.
 You can turn the tips on and off by using the menu button on the right controller.
 The tutorial is directly accessible.
 Some small other changes...


Have fun !
